name: Wham
listed_description: Structural variants (SVs) in Genomes by directly applying association tests to BAM files.
reason: Repo is a structural-variant caller (wham/whamg), not big-integer arithmetic; the guessed category was wrong. README, wiki (one Home page) and benchmarking/ directory (CHM1, PHASE3-1KG, SIMULATED-DATA with truth_delly.pl, truth_lumpy.pl, truth_wham.pl scripts) carry no runtime, memory or speed numbers against Delly, Lumpy or any other caller; README only discusses accuracy and says the -x CPU count depends on I/O speed. The 2015 PLoS Computational Biology paper compares sensitivity and false discovery rate against Lumpy, Delly and SoftSearch (per WebSearch snippets); the paper full text (ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, PLoS) and the 2024 BMC Genomics comparison of 11 SV callers (Joe et al., PMC10976732) that reports running time were blocked here (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND), so no runtime figure for Wham was verified. MIT licence, 109 stars, last commit 2017-05-03.
